expectations.text: Hook wording pulls from the provided review language (fear of opening the bank app, chaos months, spiky income) rather than claims any budgeting competitor could make.
expectations.evidence: Most of the 12 hooks are built directly from the review quotes: C1 h2 "I hadn't opened my bank app in four days" and h3 "I was genuinely scared of my own money" are near-verbatim derivations of "I stopped being scared to open my bank app"; C3 h1/h3 use "spiky income" verbatim from the forum quote, h2 "What if your budget flexed like your income does?" extends it; C4 h2 "A fixed budget can't survive a spiky income" reuses the same phrase; C2 h1 "POV: three payments, three random days this month" and h3 "my chaos-fixer app" echo "chaos months."
